source: Owner message on 2026-11-08 to the Claude session doing the UDA and Mission Control work.
owner_statement: new chats are still not giving me the account handoff line at the end for some reason

earlier_statements.text: at the end of each turn give me the 1-line handoff instruction for 2nd claude account
earlier_statements.where: the owner's standing preferences for his Claude chats, quoted in part

earlier_statements.text: and make sure any prompt which is part of multiple turns will give me a one line GH handoff at the end

problem: Replies in new chats ended without the account resume line and the GH handoff line. In the rules, both were reachable only through LESSON-INDEX.md, while the timestamp rule that opens every reply sits in root AGENTS.md; no rule said the resume line ends the reply, only that the handoff note holds one; and a new chat's first reply could read itself as one-turn work, outside the GH handoff trigger.
required_behavior: In the owner's project work, every final answer, a new chat's first turn included, ends with the one-line resume instruction for his other account, then one GH handoff line as the last line.

Where the session wrote the local handoff note, the resume line names it; where it couldn't, the line says so and names the Git checkpoint instead; where nothing could be saved, the line says what wasn't saved and why.
A self-contained answer, such as a translation or a quick fact, needs neither line.
basis: Root AGENTS.md, LESSON-INDEX.md entries 85 and 87, and the two patterns before this change.
scope: One line in root AGENTS.md under Per-turn bootstrap invariants; rule 5 and the reference implementation of patterns/cross-account-continuity.md; the activation, rule 2 and distinctness note of patterns/owner-requested-terminal-github-handoff.md; their LESSON-INDEX.md entries and coverage notes; the docs/INDEX.md route; this record; tests.

origin.owner_outcome: Every reply in his project work, in a new chat too, ends with the line to resume it from his other account and the GitHub handoff line.
origin.notes: The root line is a per-turn output rule like the timestamp, not a task rule, so the root's rule that task rules go in patterns does not apply. The causes are the assistant's reading of the rules; new-chat behaviour itself was not observed from this session.

execution_surfaces.surface: Root AGENTS.md, read first by every session that loads UDA
New chats and other workstreams' sessions
execution_surfaces.reason: Each session applies the rule at its next final answer after it re-fetches root AGENTS.md, which the owner's preferences ask for every reply.

nonclaims: No repository rule can reach a chat that never loaded UDA; for such a chat only the owner's own preferences apply.
A static test proves the rule's text and routing, not that every final answer carries the lines; that stays a per-turn check (WORKFLOW_ONLY).
